title: List with One Bulleted Item

illustrates.quote: To indicate that only some items in the list have bullets or other print indicators, such as pictures: a. Follow print for the symbol used as a bullet. The bullet begins in cell 1 and is followed by a space. Symbols used must be listed in a transcriber’s note or placed on the Special Symbols page.

blocks.features: Identical three numbered items to Example 8-5a; item 2 alone carries a print bullet, here a small solid black square rather than a round dot.

items.text: THE LIFE AND TIMES OF SHERLOCK HOLMES

print.notes: Demonstrates a different bullet shape (solid square) from Example 8-5a's round dot, both drawing from the transcriber-defined symbol list in 8.6.2.a.
print.printFeatures: Boxed list; numbered items 1-3, all-caps; item 2's bullet is a small solid black square to its left.

braille.notes: Line 1 ('text (cont.)', braille page number 6/'#f') is the last line of the *previous* braille page, carried into this excerpt for context, per rule 8.8.5.e's '(cont.)' convention (shown here for a bulleted list rather than an outline, so it is simply supporting context, not itself illustrating 8.8.5). Lines 2-6 are the new braille page's lines 1-5 (line 6 blank): the bullet symbol on line 4 is '_$#d' (dots for the 'Solid square' transcriber-defined symbol from 8.6.2.a), preceding item 2's number '#b4', mirroring Example 8-5a's structure but with the square-bullet symbol.
